title_zh: 京张智脉 AI 朝圣地标、荣誉展示体系与公共空间组件库
title_en: Jing-Zhang AI Spine — AI Pilgrimage Landmarks, Honor System, and Public-Space Component Library
generated_for: agent.4 AI公共空间、智能原生新业态与朝圣地标设计
summary_zh: 提出 4 个可体验、可打卡的 AI 朝圣地标，配套贯穿三重点区的荣誉步道，以及 7 类可复用公共空间组件，回应任务书不少于 3 个朝圣地标与组件库的必答要求。
summary_en: Four visitable, check-in-ready AI pilgrimage landmarks, a belt-spanning Honor Promenade, and seven reusable public-space components, satisfying the taskbook requirement of at least three pilgrimage landmarks and a component library.

landmarks.concept_zh: 以京张铁路'人'字形折返线为母题的轻型观景塔，塔顶光焰随一带实时算力/碳排数据呼吸，成为全带视觉原点与打卡地标。
landmarks.concept_en: A lightweight observation tower inspired by the railway's zigzag switch-back; its crown flame breathes with live belt compute/carbon data, serving as the visual origin and check-in landmark.
landmarks.compliance_zh: 轻型构筑物概念，不触碰文保本体、不占绿地红线，仅作概念建议。
landmarks.compliance_en: Concept lightweight structure; does not touch heritage fabric or green-line redlines; concept proposal only.

landmarks.name_zh: 中关村原点广场·开源之芯
landmarks.area_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
landmarks.concept_zh: 社区中央的圆形开源算力展亭与开发者驿站前场，屏幕实时展示开源模型贡献榜，是创业者与访客的聚集原点。
landmarks.concept_en: A circular open-compute pavilion and forecourt of the Developer Station at the community core, screening a live open-source contribution leaderboard; a gathering origin for founders and visitors.
landmarks.compliance_zh: 利用现状广场与驿站前场，不改造权属建筑。
landmarks.compliance_en: Uses the existing plaza and station forecourt; no modification of owned buildings.

landmarks.name_zh: 智脉立交·开源算力之芯
landmarks.area_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
landmarks.concept_zh: 将慢行立交节点塑为可见的'算力之芯'——透明机房与预约屏结合，公众可看见算力被谁、为何预约，体现开源与可复核。
landmarks.concept_en: Shapes an active-mobility interchange into a visible 'compute core' — transparent machine room plus reservation screens let the public see who reserves compute and why, expressing openness and reviewability.
landmarks.compliance_zh: 概念展示节点，不涉及机房工程可行性结论。
landmarks.compliance_en: Concept display node; no engineering feasibility conclusion for the machine room.

landmarks.area_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业集聚区
landmarks.concept_zh: 以古钟'回声'为意象的声光装置，企业开源贡献可触发钟声与投影，连接历史文脉与 AI 新文化，是夜间经济与文化策展的锚点。
landmarks.concept_en: A sound-light installation echoing the ancient bell; enterprise open-source contributions trigger its chime and projection, linking historical context with AI-new culture, anchoring night economy and cultural curation.
landmarks.compliance_zh: 文化装置概念，不改动文物与既有建筑。
landmarks.compliance_en: Cultural-installation concept; no alteration of heritage or existing buildings.

honor_system.name_zh: 荣誉步道（贡献/荣誉展示体系）
honor_system.concept_zh: 一条串联三重点区与绿廊的荣誉步道：以地面刻印、低柱屏与开源贡献墙，记录开发者、企业、社区与治理者的公开贡献，可匿名、可复核、可延续。
honor_system.concept_en: A promenade linking the three key areas and the green corridor: inlaid ground marks, low totems, and an open-source contribution wall record public contributions from developers, enterprises, communities, and governors — anonymous-capable, reviewable, and durable.
nodes: 北京AI原点社区·荣誉步道
众智园·开源算力之芯贡献墙
大钟寺·钟寺回声贡献榜
nodes_en: Beijing AI Origin Community · Honor Promenade
honor_system.compliance_zh: 展示体系为公共知识资产沉淀，不预设任何排名奖励的官方背书。
honor_system.compliance_en: The display system is a public-knowledge asset; it does not presuppose any officially endorsed ranking or reward.

component_library.spec_zh: 光伏+无线充电+环境感知，可选无障碍加高版
component_library.spec_en: Solar + wireless charging + ambient sensing; optional accessibility-high version

component_library.spec_zh: 慢行遮荫+发电+夜间柔光，接能源微网
component_library.spec_en: Shade + generation + soft night light; links to energy micro-grid

component_library.spec_zh: 多语切换+无障碍语音+朝圣地标导航
雨洪滞蓄+本土植物+科普标牌
component_library.spec_en: Stormwater retention + native planting + interpretive signage

component_library.spec_zh: 南北贯通+无障碍坡道+骑行友好
踩踏触发数据可视化/文化动画，低亮度护眼
component_library.spec_en: Step-triggered data viz / cultural animation; low-brightness eye-care

component_library.spec_zh: 透明展示+预约屏+可复核说明牌
component_library.spec_en: Transparent display + reservation screen + reviewable info board

compliance_note: 所有地标、荣誉节点与组件均为概念建议与参考方案，供专业团队深化；不替代法定规划，不构成工程可行性或政府审定结论，且不擅自改造企业建筑或权属空间。
